name: Smartlead
description: Smartlead cold email outreach from any AI agent: campaigns, sequences and schedules, leads and categories, master inbox replies, campaign and account analytics, sender mailboxes with warmup, and webhooks. REST API with an API key.
instructions:
## Smartlead
This connector uses the Smartlead REST API (`https://server.smartlead.ai/api/v1`) for cold email outreach: campaigns and their sequences, schedules and mailboxes, leads, replies in the master inbox, analytics, sender mailboxes with warmup, and webhooks.

**Setup**
1. In Smartlead open **Settings** and the **API Keys** section (on some plans under Settings, Integrations). API access needs a paid plan.
2. Copy the API key into `SMARTLEAD_API_KEY`.

The key travels as the `api_key` query parameter on every request; the connector adds it. It gives full access to the account, so treat it like a password.

**Campaigns**
- `smartlead_list_campaigns` first: the `id` of each campaign is the `campaign_id` of every other tool. `smartlead_get_campaign`, `smartlead_get_campaign_sequences` and `smartlead_list_campaign_email_accounts` show its setup.
- Build a campaign: `smartlead_create_campaign`, `smartlead_save_campaign_sequences`, `smartlead_update_campaign_schedule`, `smartlead_update_campaign_settings`, `smartlead_add_email_accounts_to_campaign`, `smartlead_add_leads_to_campaign`, then `smartlead_update_campaign_status` with `START`.
- `smartlead_update_campaign_status`: `START` (not ACTIVE), `PAUSED`, `STOPPED` (final) or `ARCHIVED`.
- `smartlead_save_campaign_sequences` replaces the whole sequence: read it with `smartlead_get_campaign_sequences` first, keep the step ids and send every step. Personalise with `{{first_name}}`, `{{company_name}}` and custom field names.

**Leads**
- `smartlead_list_campaign_leads` lists a campaign's leads; each row has the campaign lead map id (`id` of the row, used by `smartlead_create_lead_note`) and the lead itself (`lead.id`, used as `lead_id`).
- `smartlead_get_lead_by_email` finds a lead anywhere; `smartlead_get_lead` reads one by id; `smartlead_get_lead_campaign_overview` shows all its campaigns.
- Change a lead: `smartlead_update_lead`, `smartlead_update_lead_category` (ids from `smartlead_list_lead_categories`), `smartlead_pause_lead`, `smartlead_resume_lead`.
- Stop a lead: `smartlead_unsubscribe_lead_from_campaign` (one campaign), `smartlead_unsubscribe_lead_globally` (all campaigns, also blocks future imports), `smartlead_delete_lead_from_campaign`.
- `smartlead_add_leads_to_campaign` takes at most 400 leads per call.

**Replies**
- `smartlead_list_inbox_replies` lists replies across campaigns (filters by campaign, mailbox, category, reply time); `smartlead_get_inbox_item` opens one thread.
- To answer: `smartlead_get_lead_message_history` gives each message's `stats_id`, `message_id` and `time`; pass them as `email_stats_id`, `reply_message_id` and `reply_email_time` to `smartlead_reply_to_lead`. The reply leaves from the mailbox of that thread.
- `smartlead_create_lead_note` adds an internal note.

**Analytics**
- Per campaign: `smartlead_get_campaign_analytics` (all-time totals), `smartlead_get_campaign_analytics_by_date`, `smartlead_get_campaign_sequence_analytics` (per step and variant), `smartlead_get_campaign_statistics` (one row per sent email).
- Whole account: `smartlead_get_overall_analytics`.
- Counts are numbers of emails or leads; rates are percentages. Dates are `YYYY-MM-DD`; timestamps are ISO 8601 in UTC unless a time zone is passed.

**Mailboxes**: `smartlead_list_email_accounts` (find broken connections with `isSmtpSuccess=false`), `smartlead_get_email_account`, `smartlead_get_warmup_stats`, `smartlead_update_email_account`, `smartlead_update_warmup`.

**Webhooks**: `smartlead_list_campaign_webhooks`, `smartlead_upsert_campaign_webhook` (create, or update when `id` is given), `smartlead_delete_campaign_webhook`. Event types: `EMAIL_SENT`, `EMAIL_OPEN`, `EMAIL_LINK_CLICK`, `EMAIL_REPLY`, `EMAIL_BOUNCE`, `LEAD_UNSUBSCRIBED`, `LEAD_CATEGORY_UPDATED`.

**Agencies and lists**: `smartlead_list_clients` gives the client ids that filter campaigns and mailboxes; `smartlead_list_lead_lists` lists lead lists.

**Paging**: lists take `offset` (default 0) and `limit` (default 100; the inbox defaults to 20). Increase `offset` by `limit` until fewer rows than `limit` come back.

**Limits and errors**: Smartlead throttles bursts (about 10 requests per 2 seconds on standard plans) and answers 429; wait and retry. 401 `Invalid API Key` means a wrong key; 404 a wrong id or an id from another account; 400 names the invalid field.


**Switched off at install**: `smartlead_unsubscribe_lead_globally`, `smartlead_delete_lead_from_campaign` and `smartlead_delete_campaign_webhook`; they cannot be undone, so an admin switches them on when the team needs them.

SMARTLEAD_API_KEY.label: API key
SMARTLEAD_API_KEY.help: Smartlead: Settings, API Keys. Copy the key; API access needs a paid plan.
SMARTLEAD_API_KEY.patternMessage: Paste only the API key, without spaces or ?api_key=.

verifyHints.401: Smartlead refused the API key. Copy it again from Settings, API Keys.
verifyHints.rate_limited: Smartlead throttles bursts of requests. Wait a few seconds and try again.

tools.name: smartlead_list_campaigns
tools.description: List all email campaigns, newest first, with status (DRAFTED, ACTIVE, PAUSED, STOPPED, ARCHIVED), schedule, sending limits and tracking settings.

client_id.description: Only campaigns of this client (agency accounts), from smartlead_list_clients.

tools.name: smartlead_get_campaign
tools.description: Get one campaign: status, schedule, sending limits, stop-lead setting, tracking settings and client.

tools.name: smartlead_get_campaign_sequences
tools.description: Get the email sequence of a campaign: steps with delays, subjects, bodies and A/B variants.

tools.name: smartlead_list_campaign_email_accounts
tools.description: List the sender mailboxes attached to a campaign, with their sending limits and warmup state.

tools.name: smartlead_create_campaign
tools.description: Create an empty campaign in DRAFTED status. Then add sequences, a schedule, mailboxes and leads, and start it with smartlead_update_campaign_status.

client_id.description: Client to assign the campaign to (agency accounts).

tools.name: smartlead_update_campaign_status
tools.description: Start, pause, stop or archive a campaign. STOPPED ends the campaign for good; use PAUSED to halt sending temporarily.

status.description: New status. START launches or resumes the campaign (not ACTIVE).

tools.name: smartlead_update_campaign_settings
tools.description: Change campaign settings: name, open and click tracking, when to stop emailing a lead, plain text, follow-up percentage, AI mailbox matching, unsubscribe text.

track_settings.description: Tracking to switch off: DONT_TRACK_EMAIL_OPEN, DONT_TRACK_LINK_CLICK, DONT_TRACK_REPLY_TO_AN_EMAIL. [] tracks everything.

stop_lead_settings.description: When to stop emailing a lead.

follow_up_percentage.description: Share of daily volume reserved for follow-ups, 0-100.

enable_ai_esp_matching.description: Match each lead with a mailbox of the same email provider.

tools.name: smartlead_update_campaign_schedule
tools.description: Set when a campaign sends: time zone, weekdays, sending window, minutes between emails, new leads per day and start time.

days_of_the_week.description: Sending days, 0 = Sunday to 6 = Saturday, e.g. [1,2,3,4,5].

start_hour.description: Start of the sending window, HH:MM (24 h).

end_hour.description: End of the sending window, HH:MM (24 h).

min_time_btw_emails.description: Minimum minutes between two emails of a mailbox.

max_new_leads_per_day.description: Maximum new leads contacted per day.

schedule_start_time.description: Campaign start, ISO 8601 (UTC); omit to start as soon as the campaign is started.

tools.name: smartlead_save_campaign_sequences
tools.description: Replace the email sequence of a campaign. Send every step: steps left out are removed. Keep the id of existing steps to update them in place.

sequences.description:
Steps: [{"id": 123 (existing step, optional), "seq_number": 1, "seq_delay_details": {"delay_in_days": 0}, "subject": "Quick question, {{first_name}}", "email_body": "

Hi {{first_name}}

"}]. A/B variants go in "seq_variants": [{"subject", "email_body", "variant_label": "A"}]; follow-ups with an empty subject stay in the same thread.

tools.name: smartlead_add_email_accounts_to_campaign
tools.description: Attach sender mailboxes to a campaign so it can send from them.

tools.name: smartlead_list_campaign_leads
tools.description: List the leads of a campaign with their status, category and lead fields. Paged with offset and limit; the answer carries total_leads.

status.description: Lead status filter, e.g. STARTED, INPROGRESS, COMPLETED, PAUSED, STOPPED.

emailStatus.description: Email status filter, e.g. is_opened, is_clicked, is_replied, is_bounced, is_unsubscribed.

created_at_gt.description: Only leads added after this ISO 8601 timestamp.

last_sent_time_gt.description: Only leads emailed after this ISO 8601 timestamp.

event_time_gt.description: Only leads with an event (open, click, reply) after this ISO 8601 timestamp.

tools.name: smartlead_get_lead_by_email
tools.description: Find a lead by email address across all campaigns. Returns the lead id and fields, and the campaigns it is in.

tools.name: smartlead_get_lead
tools.description: Get one lead by its id: contact fields, custom fields and global status.

lead_id.description: Lead id (the lead.id from smartlead_list_campaign_leads or smartlead_get_lead_by_email).

tools.name: smartlead_get_lead_campaign_overview
tools.description: Show every campaign a lead is in, with its status and progress in each.

lead_id.description: Lead id (the lead.id from smartlead_list_campaign_leads or smartlead_get_lead_by_email).

tools.name: smartlead_get_lead_message_history
tools.description: Get the full email thread between a campaign and a lead: sent emails and replies with times, subjects, bodies and the stats_id and message_id needed to reply.

lead_id.description: Lead id (the lead.id from smartlead_list_campaign_leads or smartlead_get_lead_by_email).

show_plain_text_response.description: Return bodies as plain text instead of HTML.

event_time_gt.description: Only messages after this ISO 8601 timestamp.

tools.name: smartlead_add_leads_to_campaign
tools.description: Add up to 400 leads to a campaign. Leads on the global block list, unsubscribed, or already in other campaigns are skipped unless the settings say otherwise. Returns counts of uploaded, duplicate and blocked leads.

lead_list.description: Leads: [{"email": "jane@example.com", "first_name": "Jane", "last_name": "Doe", "company_name": "Acme", "custom_fields": {"role": "CTO"}}]. email is required; also phone_number, website, location, linkedin_profile, company_url.

settings.description: Import options: {"ignore_global_block_list": false, "ignore_unsubscribe_list": false, "ignore_duplicate_leads_in_other_campaign": false, "return_lead_ids": true}.

tools.name: smartlead_update_lead
tools.description: Update the fields of a lead in a campaign (email is required by the API even when unchanged).

lead_id.description: Lead id (the lead.id from smartlead_list_campaign_leads or smartlead_get_lead_by_email).

custom_fields.description: Custom fields used as {{variables}} in the sequence, e.g. {"role": "CTO"}. At most 200 fields.

tools.name: smartlead_update_lead_category
tools.description: Set the category of a lead in a campaign (Interested, Meeting Request, Not Interested, Out Of Office...), optionally pausing it.

lead_id.description: Lead id (the lead.id from smartlead_list_campaign_leads or smartlead_get_lead_by_email).

pause_lead.description: Also pause the lead in this campaign.

tools.name: smartlead_pause_lead
tools.description: Pause a lead in a campaign: no further sequence emails go out until it is resumed.

lead_id.description: Lead id (the lead.id from smartlead_list_campaign_leads or smartlead_get_lead_by_email).

tools.name: smartlead_resume_lead
tools.description: Resume a paused lead in a campaign, now or after a delay in days.

lead_id.description: Lead id (the lead.id from smartlead_list_campaign_leads or smartlead_get_lead_by_email).

resume_lead_with_delay_days.description: Days to wait before the next email (0 or omitted: right away).

tools.name: smartlead_unsubscribe_lead_from_campaign
tools.description: Unsubscribe a lead from one campaign. It receives no further emails from that campaign.

lead_id.description: Lead id (the lead.id from smartlead_list_campaign_leads or smartlead_get_lead_by_email).

tools.name: smartlead_unsubscribe_lead_globally
tools.description: Unsubscribe a lead from every campaign of the account and block future imports of the address.

lead_id.description: Lead id (the lead.id from smartlead_list_campaign_leads or smartlead_get_lead_by_email).

tools.name: smartlead_delete_lead_from_campaign
tools.description: Remove a lead from a campaign, with its progress in that campaign. The lead stays in other campaigns.

lead_id.description: Lead id (the lead.id from smartlead_list_campaign_leads or smartlead_get_lead_by_email).

tools.name: smartlead_list_lead_categories
tools.description: List the lead categories (global and custom) with ids, e.g. Interested, Meeting Request, Not Interested, Do Not Contact, Out Of Office.

tools.name: smartlead_list_inbox_replies
tools.description: List lead replies from the master inbox across campaigns, newest first, with filters for campaign, mailbox, category and reply time.

fetch_message_history.description: Also return the message history of each thread.

tools.name: smartlead_get_inbox_item
tools.description: Get one master inbox thread by its id, with lead, campaign and messages.

tools.name: smartlead_reply_to_lead
tools.description: Send a reply to a lead in an existing campaign thread, from the mailbox of that thread. Takes the stats_id and message_id of the email being answered from smartlead_get_lead_message_history.

email_stats_id.description: stats_id of the message being answered.

reply_message_id.description: message_id of the message being answered.

reply_email_time.description: time of the message being answered, ISO 8601.

reply_email_body.description: Body of the message being answered, quoted below the reply.

to_email.description: Recipient, when different from the lead.

tools.name: smartlead_create_lead_note
tools.description: Add an internal note to a lead in a campaign (shown in the master inbox).

email_lead_map_id.description: Campaign lead map id (the id of the lead row in smartlead_list_campaign_leads, also called lead_map_id).

tools.name: smartlead_get_campaign_analytics
tools.description: Get the totals of a campaign: sent, opened, clicked, replied, bounced, unsubscribed, plus lead progress counts.

tools.name: smartlead_get_campaign_analytics_by_date
tools.description: Get campaign totals (sent, opens, clicks, replies, bounces, unsubscribes) for a date range.

time_zone.description: IANA time zone for the day boundaries (default UTC).

tools.name: smartlead_get_campaign_sequence_analytics
tools.description: Get per-step and per-variant results of a campaign sequence for a date range: sent, opens, clicks, replies, positive replies, bounces.

tools.name: smartlead_get_campaign_statistics
tools.description: List the individual sent emails of a campaign with lead, step, sent time, open, click, reply and bounce state. Paged with offset and limit.

email_status.description: Only emails in this state: opened, clicked, replied, unsubscribed, bounced.

tools.name: smartlead_get_overall_analytics
tools.description: Get account-wide sending results for a date range: sent, opens, clicks, replies, positive replies, bounces and rates, optionally limited to campaigns or clients.

tools.name: smartlead_list_email_accounts
tools.description: List the sender mailboxes of the account: address, provider, daily limits, SMTP/IMAP health, warmup status and campaigns in use.

isInUse.description: true for mailboxes attached to a campaign, false for unused ones.

emailWarmupStatus.description: Warmup status filter, ACTIVE or INACTIVE.

isSmtpSuccess.description: false to find mailboxes with a broken SMTP connection.

tools.name: smartlead_get_email_account
tools.description: Get one sender mailbox with its limits, signature, connection health and warmup details.

fetch_campaigns.description: Also list the campaigns using the mailbox.

tools.name: smartlead_get_warmup_stats
tools.description: Get the warmup results of a mailbox for the last 7 days: warmup emails sent, landed in inbox, landed in spam, replies.

tools.name: smartlead_update_email_account
tools.description: Change a mailbox: daily sending limit, sender name, signature, BCC, custom tracking domain, minutes between emails.

tools.name: smartlead_update_warmup
tools.description: Turn warmup on or off for a mailbox and set its daily warmup volume, ramp-up and reply rate.

warmup_enabled.description: true to warm up, false to stop.

reply_rate_percentage.description: Share of warmup emails that get a reply, in percent.

tools.name: smartlead_list_campaign_webhooks
tools.description: List the webhooks of a campaign with their URL and event types.

tools.name: smartlead_upsert_campaign_webhook
tools.description: Create a campaign webhook, or update one when its id is passed. Smartlead POSTs the chosen events to the URL.

id.description: Webhook id to update; omit to create a new one.

webhook_url.description: HTTPS URL that receives the events.

event_types.description: Events: EMAIL_SENT, EMAIL_OPEN, EMAIL_LINK_CLICK, EMAIL_REPLY, EMAIL_BOUNCE, LEAD_UNSUBSCRIBED, LEAD_CATEGORY_UPDATED.

categories.description: For LEAD_CATEGORY_UPDATED: category names that trigger it, e.g. ["Interested"].

tools.name: smartlead_delete_campaign_webhook
tools.description: Delete a webhook of a campaign. Events stop being delivered to its URL.

tools.name: smartlead_list_clients
tools.description: List the clients of an agency (white-label) account with their ids, names and emails.

tools.name: smartlead_list_lead_lists
tools.description: List the lead lists (lead pools outside campaigns) with ids, names and lead counts.
